findings.section: Roadmap; D3 - README.md, the model in use
findings.summary: The B45 roadmap row says mai-code-2 is qualified, directly contradicting the brief's public claim and its prohibition on applying that word to the model.
findings.evidence: Brief lines 144-154 say the README does not call mai-code-2 qualified and the words `mai-code-2 is qualified` do not appear; docs/design-notes/vloop-roadmap-b18-b21.md:52 currently owns for B45: `mai-code-2` qualified, with its evidence in the Copilot design note.
findings.fix: Change the B45 roadmap row to say mai-code-2 has operational run evidence but is not yet qualified by the eval rule, matching D3.

findings.summary: The verification command for mai-code-2 and self-update includes the qualification expectation as prose on the same command line, so it is not executable PowerShell.
findings.evidence: Brief line 249 ends `... -SimpleMatch      (and 'mai-code-2 is qualified': no output)`. That parenthesized prose is parsed as part of the pwsh command rather than as a separate assertion; the Shape's close task is required to run the worked example line by line.
findings.fix: Keep the first Select-String command for `mai-code-2` and `vloop self-update`, then put `Select-String -Path README.md -Pattern 'mai-code-2 is qualified' -SimpleMatch` on its own line with `-> (no output)`.

decisions: Name both agents only where the behaviour is shared; preserve the listed Claude-specific text and mechanisms. I agree.
Give mixed teams a short README section linking to configuration.md for the full treatment. I agree.
Document mai-code-2's operational evidence without calling it qualified because the eval rule is unmet. I agree.
Include this repository's operator and architect skill wording because its team and gates are now mixed-OS and pwsh. I agree.
Locate changes by named text rather than pinning line numbers. I agree.
Keep Spanish templates and docs/domain out of scope unless a change would contradict them. I agree.
